Identity thinly sourced: map geocoding resolves a 'Hanuman Mandir' at NH-10, Singtam (PIN 737134), and Singtam listings reference a Hanuman Mandir near Lal Bazar; no published history, founding date, or festival calendar found — all undocumented facts flagged as unverified. name: Hanuman Temple
town_description: Singtam is a town on the banks of the Teesta and Ranikhola rivers about 30 km from Gangtok, where NH10 and NH510 meet. It is a transit hub for lower Sikkim and home to a mix of Hindu and Buddhist communities.

travel.airport: Nearest airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 90–100 km. Pakyong Airport is closer (~25 km) but flights are infrequent.
travel.road: On NH-10 on the Siliguri–Gangtok highway; regular taxis and shared jeeps from Gangtok (30 km), Siliguri and Rangpo.

visitor_information.best_time: March–May and October–December (typical hill-season guidance; verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published (verify); local shrines are generally open morning and evening.
